label: copy phase of very short sequences (L=3; L=4 last two outputs on certain inputs)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original or delimiter steps, and almost entirely in short sequences near the end of the copy. For L=3 it fires on ~90% of copy steps (t=4,5); the strongest activations are at t=5 (outputting the last token, recall_idx 2), and L=3 holds ~65% of activation mass. For L=4 it fires on roughly 23% of the last two copy steps (t=6,7), preferring inputs 1, p, d, f, 0; this token dependence is only partly captured. Rare weak activations occur in longer sequences (L>=5), mostly near the end of the copy and on inputs like 1 or p. It is essentially silent for L>=7 and on steps more than two outputs from the end.
